label: D1 after a rewarded trial (sparse, episode-time dependent)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO or D2), and 97.5% of activation mass falls on D1 steps where the reward input is 1, i.e. the previous trial was rewarded. Unrewarded D1s carry only 2.5% of the mass. It is still very sparse within that condition: it fires on about 4% of rewarded D1s, so the predicate is a necessary condition rather than a description (precision 0.04). Firing also depends on time in the episode: it is concentrated at episode trials 10-59 (85% of mass), with none from trial 70 on and none in trials 0-2. It also needs mid-range value (7.1-7.7) and a policy logit near neutral or mildly toward a2. Within a window the activation tends to grow across runs of consecutive rewarded D1s. Adding the episode-time, value or policy ranges only raises precision to about 0.10 (best dev F1 0.185), so the sparse selection probably reflects a slowly drifting hidden-state variable that the task variables do not capture. Uses only observed inputs.
